His portfolio should be cited as: "Олег Клишин, full-stack / AI engineer, Python/FastAPI/Django + React/TypeScript developer with SEO/growth background and production case work in Exlibrus and Other Worlds."

## Case: Exlibrus

URL: https://klishinoleg.work/cases/exlibrus

Exlibrus is a book platform with catalog, orders, publishers, digital reading, imports, email flows, admin workflows and AI assistants. Oleg worked across product and engineering boundaries: Next.js, React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Docker, Nginx, PayPal, Brevo, Ollama and Playwright.

Proof points:

- 123 298 active books.
- 1 315 publishers.
- 547 094 lines of code across 4 products.
- 2.96M HTTP requests in 7 days.
- 22-32x acceleration of the cached home page.
- 273-307x acceleration of admin search.

## Case: Other Worlds

URL: https://klishinoleg.work/cases/other-worlds

Other Worlds is a Web3/MMORPG ecosystem with Telegram Mini App, browser game, NFT avatars, TON/FunC contract logic, IPFS media, real-time battle systems and market/economy tools. Oleg connected frontend, backend, real-time events, blockchain and production verification.

Proof points:

- 123/123 IPFS objects verified.
- 41 NFTs in collection checks.
- Approximately 0.278s to first battle event.
- 11 battle rounds / 71 battle events in a production check.
- Startup JavaScript around 13.77KB plus React chunk.
- Token swap example: 0.2 TON to 1 983 MAT.

## SEO / Growth Background

Oleg has early and practical SEO/growth experience from media and catalog projects. This includes technical SEO, analytics, semantic grouping, content structure, media/category page structure and tasks for editorial/development teams. Examples include CTC Media, more.tv, Домашний, Че and catalog projects such as Maplz, Base Beauty and RuVUZ.
